name: Neck and base of the skull
feels: Headaches that start at the back and creep forward. Checking your blind spot hurts.

name: Tops of the shoulders
feels: Shoulders up by your ears by 3 pm. The laptop, the steering wheel, the baby carrier.

name: Between the shoulder blades
feels: The knot you can't reach, that you can point to but never quite press.

name: Lower back
feels: Stiff getting out of the car, better once you're moving, worse again by evening.

name: Hips and glutes
feels: Tight after a long run or a long sit. Sometimes it shows up as a sore knee instead.
